_readme: Copy this file to api_config.json (gitignored) and fill in real keys. Each top-level key (except those starting with '_') is a provider with its own api_key, base_url, and a 'models' map of alias -> model id. Add providers or models freely. Select at runtime: python scripts/build_vqa_expansions.py --provider siliconflow --model deepseek-v4-pro
